name: Treadmill exhaustion test
description: The animal runs on a motorized treadmill at a constant or increasing speed until exhaustion. Assesses endurance and exercise capacity.

parameters.label: Lane length
parameters.help: Length of the running lane, from the front wall to the rear grid.

parameters.label: Accelerating protocol
parameters.help: On: the belt accelerates from the start speed to the end speed. Off: the belt runs at the start speed throughout the trial.

parameters.label: Start speed
parameters.help: Belt speed at the start of the trial.

parameters.label: End speed
parameters.help: Belt speed reached at the end of the acceleration phase and held thereafter. Must not be lower than the start speed.

parameters.label: Acceleration duration
parameters.help: Time over which the belt speed rises linearly from the start speed to the end speed.

parameters.label: Cut-off time
parameters.help: The trial ends at this time even if the animal is still running.

inputEvents.label: Exhaustion
inputEvents.definition: The animal meets the exhaustion criterion.

inputEvents.label: Shock
inputEvents.definition: A shock or contact with the rear grid.

metrics.label: Time to exhaustion
metrics.description: Time until the animal meets the exhaustion criterion; longer times indicate greater endurance.
metrics.definition: Time of exhaustion, if it occurs by the cut-off time.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exhaustion was not scored, (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when the whole trial was recorded without exhaustion, and (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) otherwise.

metrics.label: Running time
metrics.description: Time spent running, until exhaustion or the cut-off time.
metrics.definition: Time of exhaustion, or max_trial_duration_s when the whole trial was recorded without exhaustion.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored, or (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Distance run
metrics.description: Distance covered on the treadmill during the run; longer distances indicate greater endurance.
metrics.definition: Integral of belt speed over the running time; the speed rises linearly from the start speed to the end speed over acceleration_duration_s and then remains constant.
metrics.formula: integral of speed(t) dt over [0, run_time_s]
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored, or (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Shock count
metrics.description: Number of shocks or rear-grid contacts during the run; more shocks suggest fatigue or low motivation.
metrics.definition: Shocks occurring strictly before the end of the run.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when shocks were not scored; otherwise missing for the same reason as run_time_s.
